title: Vegan Mermaid's Basket and Tartare Sauce
subtitle: with Crumbed Cauliflower and Vinegar Chips
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Cut the cauliflower into 3cm chunks. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into 1.5cm-thick chips. Finely chop the dill. Combine the breadcrumbs and half the dill in a bowl.

Crumb cauliflower: Put 2 tsp cornflour and 2 tsp water in a large bowl and stir until combined. Add the cauliflower and 1 tbs olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Add the breadcrumb mixture and, using your hands, press the breadcrumbs into the cauliflower (don't worry, not all the breadcrumbs will stick).

Roast vegetables: Put the cauliflower and any leftover breadcrumbs on a lined tray. Put the potato on the remaining lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp white wine vinegar and toss to combine. Season with salt and pepper. Roast the cauliflower and potato, swapping the trays halfway, for 25 mins or until tender.

Make tartare sauce: Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the peas. Juice half the lemon, then cut the remaining half into wedges. Combine the vegan sour cream, remaining dill and 2 tsp lemon juice in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper.

Make mushy peas and serve: Add the peas to the pan of boiling water and cook for 2 mins or until tender. Drain, then return to the pan. Add 20g vegan butter (optional), season with salt and pepper and coarsely mash (see Make it faster). Divide the cauliflower, chips and mushy peas among bowls and scatter with the toasted crumbs. Serve with the tartare sauce and lemon wedges. Enjoy!
Make it faster: For a speedier and easier alternative, serve the peas without mashing them.
